units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 6:4">ib. VI, 4</cite>) <he>מניין שבד׳</he> whence do we derive the law that he must be knocked down?; Y. ib. VI, 23ᶜ top <he>מניין שטעון ד׳</he>.—Pl. <he>דְּחִיּיוֹת</he>, <he>דְּחִיּוֹת</he>. Ib.

Y. Sabb. XIX, beg. 16ᵈ עיקר דְּחִיָּיתָן וכ׳ what they chiefly supersede is the Sabbath and that which is required for their execution is labor (otherwise forbidden).—[דְּחִיּוֹת in later Hebr. literature: the reasons for shifting the first day of Tishri in the Jewish calendar.]
